capabilities.title: Core Business Capabilities
capabilities.subtitle: End-to-end commercial infrastructure designed to scale brand reach while preserving market reputation.
capabilities.s1_desc: Direct volume purchasing with guaranteed payment terms. We maintain steady, recurring purchase orders to optimize your supply chain cash flow.
capabilities.s2_desc: Strict adherence to manufacturer Recommended Retail Prices (RRP / MAP) across all channels to avoid price erosion and channel conflict.
capabilities.s3_desc: Professional content structuring, asset optimization, and digital catalog management to elevate brand visibility and conversion.

standards.title: Commercial Standards & Operational Framework
standards.subtitle: Our commitment to ethical, compliant, and transparent B2B collaboration across the European Union.
standards.std1_desc: Strict adherence to manufacturer Recommended Retail Prices (RRP / MAP) to protect brand equity and avoid market price erosion across channels.
standards.std2_desc: Direct door-to-door delivery reception for courier parcels and palletized orders (DAP / DDP terms) with rapid stock processing.
standards.std3_desc: Fully verified for intra-community zero-rate VAT supplies (VIES). Seamless B2B accounting and compliant trade across EU member states.
standards.std4_desc: Commitment to sustainable commercial cooperation, brand integrity, and steady, recurring purchase orders based on planned demand.

how_we_work.title: How We Work With Brands
how_we_work.subtitle: A transparent four-step commercial onboarding process designed for swift, compliant partnership.
how_we_work.step1_desc: We review your catalog, establish wholesale terms, agree on MAP/RRP policies, and open our B2B dealer account.
how_we_work.step2_desc: We place planned purchase orders with 100% upfront or agreed terms via secure SEPA bank transfer (EUR).
how_we_work.step3_desc: Goods are shipped under DAP / DDP terms to our Spanish warehouse hub with rigorous intake inspection.
how_we_work.step4_desc: We actively optimize catalog representation and build recurring order forecasts to support long-term volume scaling.
